US-119-S3715.title: Chiricahua National Park Act
US-119-S3715.summary:
Chiricahua National Park Act

This bill redesignates the Chiricahua National Monument in Arizona as the Chiricahua National Park.

The bill directs the National Park Service (NPS) to (1) ensure the protection of traditional cultural and religious sites in the park, and (2) provide access to those sites by members of Indian tribes for traditional cultural and customary uses.

Upon the request of an Indian tribe, the NPS may temporarily close to general public use one or more specific areas of the park to protect traditional cultural and customary uses in the area by members of the tribe. The closure must be limited to the smallest practicable area for the minimum period necessary for the traditional cultural and religious activities.

US-119-S3715.aiSummary: The bill would rename Chiricahua National Monument in Arizona as Chiricahua National Park. It would also direct the National Park Service to protect traditional cultural and religious sites there and to let members of Indian tribes access those sites for traditional uses. If a tribe asks, the park service could temporarily close small areas of the park to the public to support those uses.

US-119-HR5929.title: Critical Minerals Supply Chain Resiliency Act of 2026
US-119-HR5929.summary:
Critical Minerals Supply Chain Resiliency Act of 2026

This bill makes certain actions taken by the Department of Defense to secure strategic and critical materials for energy infrastructure (e.g., critical minerals) eligible for an expedited environmental review. Specifically, the bill includes those actions within the scope of covered projects under the Fixing America's Surface Transportation (FAST) Act.
